spec.assertion: Authored as exactly one self-targeted Max-HP-family buff, value 8.82, durationSec 10, durationShots absent; at runtime a constant positive maxHp grant with a 600-frame window. Fails under: a pre-multiplied flat-HP value, an ATK-flavoured stat, a 20 s window, or a 'for N rounds' encoding.

Trigger kind is a per-pull charge trigger (shotFired/chargeCounter/hitCount/lastBullet) and the number of dominant-value maxHp applications equals delta's shot count (~100), i.e. >3x her burst-cast count. Fails under the nearest-wrong passive reading (S1_PASSIVE run collapses the application count) and under any burst/FB keying.

Authored as one self defPct buff, value 51.42, durationSec 20; runtime buffApply carries stat defPct value 51.42 with a 1200-frame window. Fails if 'DEF ▲' were promoted to an offensive stat (the AS_ATK sensitivity run shows such a promotion is visible in totals) or given a rounds duration.

Trigger kind burstCast, and the defPct application count equals delta's OWN burst-cast count. The S2_FB counterfactual re-keys to fullBurstEnter: because delta (Burst II) shares her tier with crown, FB-keying over-credits and the count rises; the test asserts that strictly, and asserts equality in the degenerate case where delta took every rotation so a coincidence can never read as a discrimination.

No decoy/avatar entity primitive exists. Asserts an explicit disjunction: either a single self-scoped shield effect with maxHpPct 91.68 and durationSec 10, OR the verbatim line recorded in unmodeled.burst. Fails on a silent drop, a wrong magnitude, or an ally-scoped shield (which would fire teammates' `shielded` triggers — a cross-unit over-credit).
No aggro/targeting model. Asserts the line is present in unmodeled.burst and that it was NOT encoded as a `stun` (a different mechanic). Fails on a silent drop or a substituted primitive.

No block in any slot uses an ally-family target kind, and at runtime no buffApply with casterIdx === delta emits onto a non-delta targetSlug. Fails under any ally-scoped re-reading of the three self lines.

STRIPPED run (all blocks emptied) reproduces every unit's total byte-identically, including delta's — the faithful consequence of self Max HP with no atkOfMaxHpPct consumer, inert defPct, and an unmodelled decoy/taunt. Non-vacuous because the AS_ATK control (every buff stat → atkPct) demonstrably raises delta's total, proving the comparison can see an offensive miscoding. Fails if any line was modelled as damage, ATK, or an HP→ATK conversion.

fixtures: controlComp('delta', true) for all five runs — liter B1 / crown B2 / delta / helm B3, boss Fire, focus delta, deterministic (no seed). The fixed B3 is kept ON because delta is Burst II, not Burst III: without helm the chain has no B3 and no Full Burst forms at all. Keeping crown in the comp is deliberate — she and delta share Burst II, so delta bursts only on the rotations crown cannot, which is precisely what separates a burstCast-keyed skill2 from a fullBurstEnter-keyed one (they would be indistinguishable in a comp where delta were the only unit of her tier). Runs: CONTROL (shipped), STRIPPED (all slot blocks emptied — inertness/no-leak), S1_PASSIVE (skill1 trigger→passive — nearest-wrong for the full-charge trigger), S2_FB (skill2 trigger→fullBurstEnter — nearest-wrong for the burst-cast trigger), AS_ATK (every buff stat→atkPct — sensitivity control that keeps the inertness assertions non-vacuous). Five 180 s sims, all hoisted at module scope. Override access is shape-tolerant (slot value read as Block[] or {blocks:Block[]}) and the committed override is inspected via an unmutated withPatchedOverride clone rather than a disk read.
gaps: it.skip — Decoy absorbs boss damage / holds an HP pool: no decoy entity and no incoming-damage model at scope lock (partless immortal boss, nobody takes damage), so the 91.68% payload is unobservable.
it.skip — Attract redirects boss aggro: no aggro/targeting primitive; boss behaviour is a fixed range script, so a taunt has no observable in the sim.
it.skip — DEF ▲ 51.42% changes survivability: defPct is documented inert in v1 (own DEF never touches own damage); only its presence and magnitude are assertable, not its effect.
it.skip — self Max HP ▲ 8.82% feeds an HP→ATK conversion: delta carries no atkOfMaxHpPct-style consumer, so the grant is offensively inert; the buff is pinned for a future consumer, not for damage.

NOT ASSERTED (attribution risk, deliberately omitted rather than guessed): per-bucket confirmation that delta emits no skill/burst-bucket damage events. The bucket vocabulary and damage-event unit attribution were not verifiable blind, and the STRIPPED byte-identical-totals assertion already subsumes the claim (any damage effect in any slot would move her total when removed).

FIXTURE-DEPENDENT: if delta never wins the Burst II slot from crown, the burst-cast non-vacuity assertion fails loudly rather than passing silently — that failure would be a fixture finding (needs a comp whose B2 competitor has a longer burst cooldown), not a divergence in the unit's model.
